events.name: Bomb Rain
events.desc: Bombs fall from the sky all around you.

events.name: Rupoor Rain
events.desc: Rupoors rain down. Each one costs rupees.

events.name: Blood Moon
events.desc: A horde of one enemy type from your pool.

events.name: Joke Event
events.desc: Harmless critters flood the area.

events.name: Moonfall
events.desc: Boulders fall where you stand. Keep moving.

events.name: The Stalker
events.desc: Something hunts you and hits very hard.

events.name: Phantom Army
events.desc: Invisible soldiers. The Lens shows them.

events.name: Treasure Hunt
events.desc: Find the hidden rupee in time or be frozen.

events.name: Blood Hunger
events.desc: Your health drains. Every kill heals you.

events.name: Searchlights
events.desc: Avoid the spotlights or enemies come.

events.name: Terrible Fate
events.desc: Salesmen creep closer when you look away.

events.name: Red Light Green Light
events.desc: Freeze when the moon watches or get zapped.

events.name: Echo
events.desc: A ghost walks your old path. Don't touch it.

events.name: Champion Duel
events.desc: Duel a mini-boss. Beat it to move on.

events.name: Infighting
events.desc: Two enemy groups brawl right next to you.

events.name: Time Moves w/ You
events.desc: Stand still and time stops. So does its clock.

events.name: Imposters
events.desc: Some carpenters are ReDeads in disguise.

events.name: Carpenter Uprising
events.desc: Rainbow carpenters attack. Hit them to stop.

events.name: Procession of the Dead
events.desc: A column of ReDeads marches. Don't cross it.

events.name: Poltergeist
events.desc: Rocks circle you, flash red, then fly at you.

events.name: Bullet Hell
events.desc: Mad Scrubs surround you and fire volleys.

events.name: Mirage
events.desc: Enemies come with fakes. Find the real one.

events.name: Mirror Dance
events.desc: Dancers copy your every move.

events.name: Swarm Night
events.desc: A huge Keese swarm fills the sky.

events.name: Majora Looms
events.desc: Majora's Mask throws boss masks at your spot.

events.name: Sky Leviathan
events.desc: A giant fish circles in the sky. Harmless.

events.name: Tingle Air Raid
events.desc: Tingle drops bombs. Pop his balloon to stop him.

events.name: Cursed Tag
events.desc: Hit an enemy to pass the curse before it blows.

events.name: Pop Quiz
events.desc: Name the song. Wrong costs half your hearts.

events.name: Low Gravity
events.desc: Link floats. Jumps and falls go floaty.

events.name: Moonlit Prey
events.desc: Kill the glowing foe for rupees, or get hurt.

traits.name: Armored
traits.desc: Takes half damage from every hit.

traits.name: Summoner
traits.desc: Calls in extra enemies every 12 seconds.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.desc: Burns you if you get too close.

traits.name: Blinker
traits.desc: Teleports near you if you keep your distance.

traits.name: Vengeful
traits.desc: Drops a bomb from the sky when it dies.

traits.name: Brutal
traits.desc: You take 50% more damage while near it.

traits.name: Splitter
traits.desc: Splits into two copies when slain.

traits.name: Enraged
traits.desc: Faster and hits harder below half health.

traits.name: Thorned
traits.desc: Stings you back when you hit it with a sword.

traits.name: Leech
traits.desc: Heals itself whenever it hurts you.

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.desc: Its first killing blow leaves it at half health.

traits.name: Thief
traits.desc: Steals 10 rupees whenever it hurts you.

traits.name: Cloaked
traits.desc: Keeps fading out of sight. Lens reveals it.

muts.name: Thin Skin
muts.desc: They take 50% more damage.

muts.name: Tough Crowd
muts.desc: Enemies have 50% more health.

muts.name: Vengeful Dead
muts.desc: Slain enemies leave a falling bomb behind.

muts.name: Reinforcements
muts.desc: Kills may call in a replacement enemy.

muts.name: Elite Foes
muts.desc: 1 in 4 enemies has a random trait.

muts.name: Heart Lock
muts.desc: They can't heal within 2 hearts of their max.

muts.name: Open Wounds
muts.desc: After a hit, they can't heal for 10 seconds.

muts.name: Mana Tax
muts.desc: Magic costs double.

muts.name: Ammo Tax
muts.desc: Arrows, bombs, nuts and sticks go twice as fast.

muts.name: Butterfingers
muts.desc: Every hit they take costs 5 rupees.

muts.name: Rupee Rot
muts.desc: They lose a rupee every 20 seconds.

muts.name: Cold Water
muts.desc: Swimming drains health (not as Zora).

muts.name: Restless Earth
muts.desc: If they stand still 4 seconds, a boulder falls on them.

muts.name: Dark Nights
muts.desc: Nights are much darker.

muts.name: Emboldened
muts.desc: Their Nemesis gains a level.

muts.name: Hunted
muts.desc: Their Nemesis turns up far more often.

muts.name: Moon Tears
muts.desc: Boulders fall on them now and then.

muts.name: Ambushers
muts.desc: New areas may greet them with enemies.

muts.name: Keese Escort
muts.desc: A few Keese follow them everywhere.

muts.name: Weak Recovery
muts.desc: All healing is halved.

muts.name: Bleeding
muts.desc: Every hit takes two more hearts a moment later.

curses.name: Restless Moon
curses.desc: Events come a third more often.

curses.name: Lingering Dread
curses.desc: Events last half again as long.

curses.name: Fierce Moon
curses.desc: Events are one step harder.

curses.name: Twin Omens
curses.desc: Combo events are much more common.

curses.name: Moon's Favorite
curses.desc: One event comes up half the time.

curses.name: Blood Nights
curses.desc: A Blood Moon rises every night at 6 PM.

curses.name: Night Terrors
curses.desc: Events come twice as often at night.

curses.name: Silent Moon
curses.desc: No warning or roulette before events.

curses.name: Unseen Omen
curses.desc: Events hide their names.

curses.name: Aftershocks
curses.desc: A short Bomb Rain follows every event.

curses.name: Impending Doom
curses.desc: Moon Pressure is on: events get worse as the moon gets closer.

curses.name: Legion
curses.desc: Blood Moon hordes are twice as big.

curses.name: Glass Moon
curses.desc: They take double damage during events.

curses.name: Encore
curses.desc: Every event comes back a minute later.

curses.name: Meteor Shower
curses.desc: Boulders fall on them during every event.

curses.name: Ambush
curses.desc: New areas may greet them with a Blood Moon.

curses.name: Bell Toll
curses.desc: Events strike every 3 hours on the clock.

curses.name: Hex
curses.desc: Cursed Tag joins every event.

curses.name: Moon's Wrath
curses.desc: Every 5 events they survive, the next is a harder combo.

curses.name: Weightless Moon
curses.desc: Low gravity whenever an event is running.

pouch.name: Portal Stones
pouch.desc: Place two, then step in one to hop to the other.

pouch.name: Giga Blade
pouch.desc: Arm it: their next sword hits do triple damage.

pouch.name: Gravity Bomb
pouch.desc: Pulls enemies together, then blows them up.

pouch.name: Recall Feather
pouch.desc: Snaps them back to where they stood 10 seconds ago.

pouch.name: Storm Rod
pouch.desc: Lightning strikes up to 5 nearby enemies.

pouch.name: Moon Shield
pouch.desc: Raise it: it absorbs their next hits.

pouch.name: Blood Pact
pouch.desc: 60 seconds: deal double damage, take double.

pouch.name: Nemesis Compass
pouch.desc: 60 seconds: shows where their Nemesis is.

pouch.name: Smoke Veil
pouch.desc: Enemies lose track of them for 10 seconds.

pouch.name: Decoy
pouch.desc: Drops a decoy that draws enemies for 12 seconds.

pouch.name: Moon Dash
pouch.desc: Blinks them a short way forward, through enemies (3 uses).

stats.name: Power
stats.desc: +25% damage per point when it hits them.

stats.name: Tracking
stats.desc: Moves toward them faster and shows up more often. At 3+ it follows them in from next door.
